announcement.title: 💞 Stylish Relationship Tracker v1.5.1
announcement.content:
Status Tags and Player Editing

  • Set global and personal status tags in Relationship Manager > General. GMs control global statuses; personal selections stay on each character's relationship, even when progress is shared. Deceased, Missing, Injured, and Imprisoned are included, with custom types and portrait effects.
  • Players with the required permission can edit personal records, ranks, progress, and personal statuses without a GM while an owner of their Actor is online. Party-shared progress is also supported after a GM connects once with this version. Changes remain saved when other members are offline.
  • Rank Macros and earned Item rewards wait for the GM. Save notifications and the Manager show what is pending. Processed changes and rewards are not repeated on reconnect.
  • Drop Items onto rank reward rows in Progress. Each reward is granted once when its rank is first reached after setup; party members have separate delivery records.
  • Drop Foundry documents into supported relationship and organization text to create links. On Gift approval, GMs can choose the reaction and edit its dialogue.
  • Improved Adventurer's Ledger hover performance. Fixed blocked Gift approvals, typing during reactions, oversized map portraits, and an error when closing the Manager.
